programs.title: Home Free
programs.desc: Herb and Audrey have had a near perfect relationship for over fifty years. This anniversary Herb has a few surprises in store for his three estranged daughters. Herb, having recently been diagnosed with a fatal brain tumor, announces that he is choosing to die on his own terms and is not seeking treatment. As the daughters grapple with one another and wrestle their own demons, their father's condition worsens, and Audrey realizes that she's not ready to say goodbye to her true love.

programs.title: Finally Caught
programs.desc: A devoted mother vanishes after heading to pick up her children. Her car is found abandoned.

programs.title: Targeted for Murder
programs.desc: After a Midwestern insurance salesman is discovered on the floor of his office with an extra hole in his head, his wife, family, community, and church are drawn into a web of greed, infidelity, and murder.

programs.title: One Way Mirror
programs.desc: When Israel Keyes is apprehended in connection to Samantha Koenig's disappearance, police have no idea that it will lead them to a string of other murders; despite promising to help authorities solve other missing persons cases and unsolved murders, Keyes is focused on controlling the narrative in the media about how he is portrayed, and the FBI must bite their tongues and suffer through the ramblings of a serial killer if they hope to find out the truth.

programs.title: One Way Mirror
programs.desc: Lori calls the police after her husband falls overboard during a boating trip on a lake; what starts as a search and rescue operation evolves into something darker as an investigation reveals more information.

programs.title: Raging Grace
programs.desc: Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart.

programs.title: Missing From Fire Trail Road
programs.desc: A documentary detailing the case of Mary Ellen Johnson-Davis, a Native American woman who disappeared in 2020. Her story exposes how hundreds of indigenous women continue to go missing in the USA, perpetuating trans-generational traumas.
